answer: Farming becomes a pulse bet on surviving 66 epochs of grading, and every copper settlement recomputes the signal schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 66 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
